layers.description: 1-metre 3DEP DEM downloaded from The National Map (or user-supplied file)
layers.summary: Raw digital elevation model for the project extent.

layers.description: Hillshade of the DEM (GDAL DEMProcessing). Produced for all DEM sources.
layers.summary: Shaded-relief rendering of the DEM for visual reference.

layers.description: Topographic slope in degrees (GDAL DEMProcessing Horn method, calculated from the raw DEM)
layers.summary: Slope raster in degrees derived from the raw DEM.

layers.description: DEM with topographic sinks filled (TauDEM pitremove)
layers.summary: Hydrologically conditioned DEM with sinks removed.

layers.description: DEM hydrologically conditioned via least-cost depression breaching (WhiteboxTools BreachDepressionsLeastCost)
layers.summary: DEM with depressions breached along least-cost paths to enforce drainage.

layers.description: D8 flow direction raster (1-8 encoding, TauDEM d8flowdir)
layers.summary: D8 flow direction grid encoding the steepest-descent neighbor for each cell.

layers.description: D8 flow accumulation — cell values are upstream cell counts (TauDEM aread8). Multiply by (cell size in metres)² to convert to m².
layers.summary: Upstream contributing area in cells for every grid cell.

layers.description: Binary stream mask: 1 where upstream contributing area ≥ StreamThreshold cells, 0 elsewhere (TauDEM threshold)
layers.summary: Binary raster identifying stream cells at the configured contributing-area threshold.
Strahler stream-order assigned to each stream cell.

layers.description: Subwatershed raster — one unique integer value per stream reach (TauDEM streamnet)
layers.summary: Raster of subwatershed catchments, one integer per reach.

layers.description: Polygon footprints of every 3DEP tile downloaded. Only produced when `dem.source` is `tnm`. Contains sub-layers tile_footprints and data_footprints sharing the same schema.
layers.summary: Polygon footprints of downloaded 3DEP tiles with per-tile provenance attributes.

columns.name: filename
columns.description: Original filename of the 3DEP tile

columns.name: source_path
columns.description: Full path or URL of the source tile

columns.name: original_epsg
columns.description: EPSG code of the tile's native CRS

columns.name: original_crs_name
columns.description: Name of the tile's native CRS

columns.name: is_reprojected
columns.description: 1 if the tile was reprojected to match the mosaic CRS, 0 otherwise

columns.name: final_epsg
columns.description: EPSG code of the mosaic CRS used for this tile

columns.name: final_crs_name
columns.description: Name of the mosaic CRS used for this tile

columns.name: width_px
columns.description: Tile width in pixels

columns.name: height_px
columns.description: Tile height in pixels

columns.name: resolution_m
columns.description: Pixel resolution in metres

columns.name: file_size_mb
columns.description: File size in megabytes

columns.name: nodata_value
columns.description: NoData sentinel value

columns.name: x_min_native
columns.description: West edge in native CRS units

columns.name: y_min_native
columns.description: South edge in native CRS units

columns.name: x_max_native
columns.description: East edge in native CRS units

columns.name: y_max_native
columns.description: North edge in native CRS units

layers.description: Hydrology derivatives GeoPackage containing two sub-layers: (1) network_intersected — one feature per stream reach (columns listed below); (2) subwatersheds — one polygon per subwatershed with a single WSNO field (integer, joins to LINKNO in network_intersected).
layers.summary: Stream network reaches and subwatershed polygons derived from the DEM.

columns.name: LINKNO
columns.description: Unique reach identifier (TauDEM streamnet)

columns.name: DSLINKNO
columns.description: LINKNO of the immediately downstream reach; -1 = outlet

columns.name: USLINKNO1
columns.description: LINKNO of the first upstream reach; -1 = headwater

columns.name: USLINKNO2
columns.description: LINKNO of the second upstream reach; -1 = none

columns.name: DSNODEID
columns.description: TauDEM internal node ID (not populated in practice)

columns.name: strmOrder
columns.description: Strahler stream order

columns.name: Length
columns.description: Channel path length along D8 grid

columns.name: Magnitude
columns.description: Number of upstream headwater reaches

columns.name: USContArea
columns.description: D8 contributing area at the upstream end of the reach

columns.name: DSContArea
columns.description: D8 contributing area at the downstream end of the reach

columns.name: strmDrop
columns.description: Elevation drop from upstream to downstream end

columns.name: Slope
columns.description: Average channel gradient (strmDrop / Length)

columns.name: StraightL
columns.description: Straight-line distance between reach endpoints

columns.name: WSNO
columns.description: Subwatershed number; matches subwatersheds layer and raster

columns.name: DOUTEND
columns.description: Distance along flow path from downstream end to outlet

columns.name: DOUTSTART
columns.description: Distance along flow path from upstream end to outlet

columns.name: DOUTMID
columns.description: Distance along flow path from reach midpoint to outlet

columns.name: level_path
columns.description: Unique level-path ID assigned by walking the network from headwaters to outlet (Step 7)

layers.description: Debug layer: point feature at every pixel where the original DEM elevation exceeds the breach-conditioned DEM by ≥ 0.001 m (1 mm). Only produced when --debug is set.
layers.summary: Debug points where DEM breaching altered the elevation by ≥ 1 mm.

columns.name: diff_m
columns.description: Magnitude of elevation change (original DEM minus breach DEM) at this pixel

layers.description: LandFire Existing Vegetation Type (EVT) raster clipped to the project extent.
layers.summary: LANDFIRE EVT land-cover classification clipped to the project extent.

layers.description: Road and railway centrelines fetched from AWS S3 Tables via Athena and clipped to the project extent.
layers.summary: Road and railway centrelines clipped to the project extent.

layers.description: Railway centrelines fetched from AWS S3 Tables via Athena and clipped to the project extent.
layers.summary: Railway centrelines clipped to the project extent.
